A genuinely new failure category for this project's own disclosed record, distinct from Finding 6 (real non-MEP linework) since a legend page isn't excluded by any existing stroke-family or wall-vouch check -- worth flagging for a future refusal-corpus addition, not attempted here.
2) REJECTED: `083_MA_Town_Offices_Facilities_HVAC_System_Upgrades.pdf` sheet H2.0 (25.75 LF, `6"O SA` round duct, `size-binding:beside`) -- a marked crop showed both of `trace_run`'s own reported dead ends sit only 9px apart (the same physical riser's own two rails), meaning the walk went UP one rail of a double-line round duct symbol, around a small connector/damper detail at the top, and back DOWN the other rail -- the same 'both rails of one riser, not two ends of one run' trap `weld-county-m1-0.json`'s own review_basis already named and worked around by seeding on a single rail deliberately. This auto-discovered seed did the opposite (walked both), so its own 'length' roughly double-counts one real, shorter riser drop. Not used; a clean one-rail reseed on this same real duct riser is real, disclosed future work, not attempted this pass.

3) ACCEPTED (this golden): the SAME `083_MA...` PDF's own sheet H3.0, a real refrigerant-piping run on a literal `m-pipe` PDF layer (a lowercase, informally-named but genuinely real layer -- confirmed via direct `sheetInfo` layer inspection, 110 segments), `stroke-family:layer-name` grade. Both ends confirmed via a marked render crop as real physical stops: the forward end sits exactly at a real FCU-4 fan-coil-unit connection point; the backward end sits at a real riser-up symbol (a black circle, matching this same sheet's own printed note 'RS&RL UP TO ROOF, CONNECT TO HP-1/HP-2/HP-3 ACCORDINGLY' for the continuation beyond this golden's own scope). The run's own size (round 0.75in) is confirmed by a real printed `3/4"O` callout with a literal leader line pointing directly at this run's own longest segment -- the same segment `size_overrides` keys to (index 2, the bench's own `seedOnLongestSegment` convention). `run.system` is left as the engine's own literal, verified read (`piping`) rather than a more specific guess (`RL`/`RS`) this project's own doctrine would call unconfirmed: the nearby printed context (`RS&RL`, `2 PIPE REFNET HEADER`) makes 'a refrigerant line' a safe read, but which SPECIFIC line (suction vs. liquid) of the pair is genuinely unclear from this crop alone -- `piping` is the real, disclosed value `trace_run` itself produced from the real `m-pipe` layer name, not a fabricated nicer-sounding label, matching this project's own 'trust and disclose the engine's real output, don't invent a cleaner one' discipline.
